<style id="ax-s127">
/* ============ Workup stages as headed cards (s127, Jonathan 2026-10-09: "the specifiers are too low profile"; layout B) ============
   Each stage of a diagnostic workup reads as one unit: the stage label (who or when) is the header band of its card,
   the test name follows in bold, and the results sit indented on an accent rule. A stage of tests done together (tile.first) keeps the accent tint; a first branch does not.
   A stage with no tests (eg the closing "Then") keeps its label as a pill above plain text. workupread.js moves each
   label into its card at load; the label text is unchanged. */
.lcp .pt::before{top:14px;width:13px;height:13px;left:2px}
.lcp .pt::after{left:7.5px;top:22px}
.lcp .pt{padding:0 0 16px 30px}
.lcp .tile > .when{display:block;margin:-11px -14px 11px;padding:9px 14px 8px;border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:750;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--chart-ink);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--recess) 65%,var(--raised));box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--hair)}
.lcp .tile.first > .when{color:var(--accent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 11%,var(--raised));box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 28%,transparent)}
.lcp .tile .wr2{margin-left:10px;padding-left:12px;border-left:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 45%,transparent)}
.lcp .tile .wr2 + .wr2{border-top:0;padding-top:4px}
.lcp .pt > .when{display:inline-block;margin:0 0 8px;padding:3px 11px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;line-height:1.35;color:var(--chart-ink);background:var(--recess);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hair)}
.lcp .pt > .when + .pt-tx{margin-top:0}
.lcp .pt:first-child .tile:not(.first) > .when{color:var(--chart-ink)}
.lcp .pt:has(> .tile.first)::before{background:var(--accent)}
.lcp .pt.end{padding-bottom:4px}
</style>
</head>

<script>
/* Workup stages as headed cards (s127): move each stage label into its card as the card's header. Stages without a card
   keep their label where it is. Runs once at load; nothing is stored. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  function init(){
    document.querySelectorAll('figure.lcp .pt').forEach(function(pt){
      var w = pt.querySelector(':scope > .when'), t = pt.querySelector(':scope > .tile');
      if(w && t) t.insertBefore(w, t.firstChild);
    });
  }
  if(document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init); else init();
})();
</script>
</body>
